newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SAfrica stock exchange to help set up Gabon bourse.
newsitem.headline: SAfrica stock exchange to help set up Gabon bourse.

text.p: South Africa's Johannesburg Stock Exchange (JSE) is to help set up a bourse in the oil rich West African country of Gabon, the two nations said on Friday.
Gabonese president Omar Bongo has just concluded a three day trip to South Africa to discuss bilateral and pan-African issues with President Nelson Mandela.

"The two presidents agreed to entrust the Johannesburg Stock Exchange (JSE) with the task of finalising the establishment of a stock exchange in Gabon," the countries said in a joint statement issued at the end of the trip.
No one at the JSE was immediately available for comment.

Bongo also appealed for more South African firms to invest in Gabon, especially its Poubara II electrification project. South African interests have already taken a stake in Gabon's Comilog manganese mine.
As part of the trip the countries signed a declaration of intent for accords on the reciprocal protection of investments, the elimination of double taxation and a maritime agreement.
